common_photographic_design.subject: one clearly adult woman; attached image used only for visible face and hair appearance
common_photographic_design.body_support: left knee on a dark knee pad with direct ground contact; right sole flat in front; left toes tucked against ground behind, with hips supported between left knee and right foot
common_photographic_design.directions: right shin roughly upright; left thigh descending toward the planted left knee; torso angled slightly forward over the support base
common_photographic_design.lighting: neutral-white work light from camera left at face height; a small oval nose-shadow on camera-right cheek that does not connect to the cheek shadow, camera-left cheek visibly brighter; small bright catchlight in each visible eye
common_photographic_design.composition: single full-body photograph at close enough distance for face and three lower-body contact points to be legible; face turned toward camera; full footwear visible; no occlusion of knees or feet
common_photographic_design.style: real photographic outdoor maintenance moment, restrained expression, no sexualized pose or narrative
